findings.issue: The projection catalog is built from previously persisted history only. The current chart snapshot is not added until after rendering, so observed-decay estimates always lag one production refresh; local builds never incorporate the current snapshot at all.
findings.suggestion: Merge today's resolved grosses into an in-memory, same-date-deduplicated history before building projections, while persisting those rows only for non-local runs.

findings.issue: The chart's date axis is derived solely from forecast-history rows. Because degraded production runs intentionally append no forecast rows, those refresh dates disappear entirely and paths connect across them instead of showing the required gap.
findings.suggestion: Build the date axis from all production refresh dates, such as box-office history or a run log, then map missing forecast observations to null.

findings.issue: Alias resolution can collapse two originally distinct roster titles into the same canonical film after load-time validation. Scoring then counts that film multiple times, potentially as both a ranked pick and dark horse, violating the 13-distinct-title rule.
findings.suggestion: Revalidate each canonicalized roster and reject aliases that create duplicate ranked or dark-horse titles, naming the affected player and collision.
